meta.name: notion-meeting-intelligence
meta.description: Prepares meeting materials by gathering context from Notion, enriching with Claude research, and creating both an internal pre-read and external agenda saved to Notion. Helps you arrive prepared with comprehensive background and structured meeting docs.

copy.tagline: 自动整理会议资料并生成议程文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从Notion收集信息来准备会议材料。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically gather meeting context and generate agenda docs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to collect Notion info to prepare meeting materials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 当你要准备会议时，Claude 会从 Notion 搜索相关页面，获取背景信息，并用自身知识补充行业洞察，然后创建两份文档：一份内部预读材料（给参会团队）和一份外部议程（给所有参与者），最后保存到 Notion 并建立链接。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 为某个会议做准备时触发，例如说“帮我准备明天的客户会议”。

say.text: 帮我准备下周的产品评审会，主题是移动端改版。
为今天下午的客户演示会议创建议程。
say.note: Claude 会快速创建外部议程，并可能跳过内部预读。

howto.what_en: When asked to prep for a meeting, Claude searches Notion for context, enriches with its own knowledge, and creates two documents: an internal pre-read for the team and an external agenda for all participants, saved to Notion with cross-links.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to prepare for a meeting, e.g., 'Prepare me for tomorrow's customer meeting.'

say_en.text: Prepare me for next week's product review on mobile redesign.
say_en.note: Claude will search Notion and generate pre-read and agenda.

say_en.text: Create an agenda for this afternoon's customer demo.
